resources.ollamaHostHelper: The endpoint your bot will hit. Leave blank to default to http://localhost:11434. If your bot runs in Docker and Ollama runs on the host, use http://host.docker.internal:11434 (Mac/Windows) or your host's LAN IP (Linux). Cloud deploys need a publicly reachable Ollama endpoint.
